title.en: A Buddha sheltered by seven naga heads

alt.en: A black-and-white photograph shows a broken stone bust with closed eyes beneath a fan of seven serpent heads.
alt.zh: 黑白照片中，残存石雕胸像双目闭合，头上展开七个蛇首。

caption.en: Buddha Protected by a Seven-headed Naga, late twelfth–early thirteenth century, Cambodia; sandstone, Met 36.96.5. Monochrome photograph.
caption.zh: 《七首那伽护佑佛像》，十二世纪晚期至十三世纪初，柬埔寨；砂岩，大都会36.96.5。黑白照片。

interpretation.en: The museum connects this fragment to Buddhist patronage around Angkor Thom during Jayavarman VII’s reign. It depicts the Buddha, not the king; the missing lower body limits reconstruction of the original sculpture.
interpretation.zh: 馆方将此残像联系于阇耶跋摩七世统治时期吴哥通附近的佛教赞助。表现对象是佛陀而非国王；下部缺失也限制了对原像的复原。

note.en: Official item page marks the image Public Domain; the Met API confirms isPublicDomain=true.
note.zh: 官方单件页面将图像标为公共领域，Met API亦确认isPublicDomain=true。

title.zh: 榆树纤维织物与缝绣纹样

alt.en: The back of a brown robe has broad rectangular sleeves, dark cuffs and hem, and blue-black curving patterns around the shoulders.
alt.zh: 褐色长衣背面有宽阔矩形袖，袖口及下摆深色，肩背处排列蓝黑色曲线纹样。

caption.en: Ainu robe, nineteenth century; appliquéd and embroidered elm fibre, Met 1999.247.1. Back view.
caption.zh: 阿伊努长衣，十九世纪；榆树纤维织物、贴布与刺绣，大都会1999.247.1。背面。

interpretation.en: The back view makes the applied and embroidered decoration visible across the shoulders. Its wide sleeves contrast with tapered sleeves on other Ainu garments; the maker’s name is unrecorded.
interpretation.zh: 背面图可清楚观察肩部的贴布与刺绣。宽袖与其他阿伊努衣物的收窄袖形形成对比，具体制作者姓名未详。

items.creator: Unrecorded artist
